tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# Create the Gateway named app-gateway with traefik gatewayClassName and an HTTP listener on port 8000
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
metadata:
  name: app-gateway
  namespace: default
spec:
  gatewayClassName: traefik
  listeners:
  - name: http
    protocol: HTTP
    port: 8000
    term: v1beta1
---
# Create the HTTPRoute named app-route
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute

metadata:
  name: app-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: app-gateway
  hostnames:
  - "app.example.com"
  rules:
  - matches:
    - path:
        pathPrefix: /app
    backend:
      service:
        name: app-service # Assuming the service is named app-service based on common practice, or I'll check if I can infer it.
        port: 80
EOF"}
